profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Open Source Program Office at Capital One
profile.summary: I'm obsessed with user experience allow empathy to guide towards the right solution. My genetics degree gives me a unique perspective when working with cross functional teams to build products. I devour data and use the scientific method to support or refine my hypothesis regarding features. Once completed, my software engineering degree will help me bridge the gap between design, business stakeholders, and developers. I love technology and introducing users to products that could enhance their lives forever.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Open Source Project Office / OSPO team where I:
- Currently leading the end-to-end delivery of Open Source Software Ingestion API, overseeing database schema design and infrastructure deployment (Lambda, AppSync, Fargate) to provide high-fidelity End of Life (EOL) data and insights for critical enterprise assets.
- Institutionalized a "Culture of Design" by moderating weekly technical design reviews, providing architectural oversight, and unblocking complex implementation hurdles for multiple work streams
- Mentored and developed high-potential talent, guiding junior engineers through stretch assignments in Go and AWS, while co-facilitating enterprise-wide competency reviews
- Influenced Cross-Functional Alignment by representing the team in the Platform Community of Practice (CoP), driving Enterprise Architecture toward better data quality and compliance standards
- Architected and spearheaded the migration to a OPA Policy-as-Code (PaC) model for an internal product focused on tracking open source software versions through their lifecycle, achieving 100% automation of the version lifecycle updates to drastically reduce enterprise-wide end of life usage and reduce security risks
- Leading an effort to enhance the data output for SBOMs to provide dependency insights and other metrics for direct and transitive dependencies
- Architected an internal tool displaying various health metrics for open source packages provide guidance on packages allowed for us for the enterprise
 -Transformed product vision by reframing internal tools as a Data Product, scaling architecture to support downstream consumer teams through highly flexible API design
- Identified and filled architectural gaps by initiating deep dives into AWS design patterns and Cloudwaze metrics, directly improving the maintainability and uptime of mission-critical services
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Software Architectural Design and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a DevOps team where I:
- Established the UI/UX Foundation for the Tech Catalog by developing a standardized Angular component library, ensuring design consistency and code reusability across all future frontend work streams
- Standardized the various processes, creating documentation and repeatable workflows that significantly reduced onboarding time for new hires
- Engineered an InnerSourced Docker Image Validation stage in the enterprise-wide Jenkins pipeline, improving release confidence and reducing non-compliant build costs across the entire enterprise in Go
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Go (Programming Language) and +4 skills

positions.title: Sr Platform Engineer
positions.description:
Work with stakeholders to define application and user experience requirements, design product features including mock-ups, clickable prototypes and usability testing. Communicate to business and technical partners on incidents as they occur when they impact system performance or availability. Collaborate with partners to engineer an integrated, end-to-end support frameworks across technology layers and enhanced automated support capabilities. Support and perform testing required to ensure successful implementation of solutions into Production.
Accomplishments include:
➢	Winning team hackathon with web app POC. App became the organization’s focus and leading IT support product the year. App reduced 35% of IT support tickets through automation and self-service.
➢	Won most engaging and motivational talk for presentation about the journey from hackathon pitch to successful progressive web app in less than a year.
➢	Awarded a TechX award for technical excellence due to the positive impact web app has had on the productivity of the enterprise.
positions.insights: Feature Engineering, User Experience (UX) and +8 skills
